chapters.title: 一个矩阵，可以拆成三次动作
chapters.en: A matrix acts as rotate, stretch, rotate.

chapters.title: 先用 Vᵀ 改变输入方向
chapters.en: Rotate the input directions with Vᵀ.

chapters.title: 再按两个奇异值分别伸缩
chapters.en: Stretch the aligned axes by the singular values.

chapters.title: 最后用 U 放到输出方向
chapters.en: Finally rotate the result with U.

chapters.title: 秩一近似，把第二个方向压到零
chapters.en: Rank-one truncation removes the second singular direction.

chapters.title: 截断误差，对应被舍弃的方向
chapters.en: Truncation error comes from the discarded direction.

checkpoints.name: 先用 Vᵀ 改变输入方向
